Context: 12. Relaxation of consultation norms in respect of CGHS beneficiaries aged 75 years and above

## 12. Relaxation of consultation norms in respect of CGHS beneficiaries aged 75 years and above  
- (i) CGHS beneficiaries aged 75 years and above shall be permitted to seek direct OPD Consultation from Specialists of private hospitals empanelled under CGHS without referral from CGHS
- Wellness Centre.
